messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — the token attribution pipeline is showing ~30% fewer events in the last 4h vs baseline. Noticed when correlating cost buckets. Can owners confirm?
Samir P: Saw the same. Dashboard spike in queue_length and lambda throttles around 11:05 UTC.
Jun Park: I can look — which demux service are you referencing? demux-v2 or legacy?
Maya R: demux-v2 for new events; legacy handles fallback. The loss looks like it didn't hit fallback.
Casey L: Pinged in infra-sig earlier, there was a deploy to demux-v2 at 10:58 that changed concurrency hints.
infra-bot: deploy demux-v2@r12 merged by @casey at 2026-03-17T10:58Z — rollout completed to prod-1, prod-2. No immediate errors in CI.
Samir P: Can someone share the relevant logs? best to search for 'Throttle' and 'DroppedMessage' across prod-1.
Jun Park: grabbing logs now. quick query: ```json
filter: message like "%Throttle%" OR message like "%DroppedMessage%"
service: demux-v2
start: 2026-03-17T10:45:00Z
end:   2026-03-17T11:30:00Z
```
Maya R: Also correlating with our token-cost attribution: aggregated daily token counts for `embed_create` are down ~28% — that's how this surfaced.
Casey L: Short-term mitigation: re-opened concurrency to previous setting and paused new deploys. Rolling back is option B if errors continue.
Samir P: FYI: if fallback path didn't trigger, event schema might have changed. Did the deploy include an event-field rename?
Casey L: There was a minor schema tweak in the payload: renamed `client_id` -> `cid` in the transform step. I noted it in the PR but may have missed cross-team impact.
Jun Park: That would break attribution joins in the analytics pipeline (we join on client_id). If demux started emitting `cid`, downstream matchers won't attribute tokens.
Maya R: OK — actionables: 1) Casey to revert `cid` change or add compatibility shim in demux by EOD. 2) Jun to run a re-ingest smoke that maps both fields and report counts. 3) Samir to monitor latency and queue metrics and post a summary.
Casey L: I can add a compatibility shim (map `cid` -> `client_id`) and push within the hour. If that fails, will revert.
Samir P: I'll post a short pulse in 30m with queue_length, avg_latency_p90, and dropped_count.
Jun Park: Running re-ingest test now with small batch. Preliminary: when mapping `cid` -> `client_id` counts jump back to ~99% of baseline. Will share full numbers in 15.
Maya R: Great — once Jun confirms, analytics-sig please run the token-cost attribution job for the last 4h to validate.
analytics-sig: Ack. We'll kick off a targeted attribution run against the archived stream and ping here with deltas.
Casey L: shim deployed to prod-1 and prod-2 at 11:40Z. No obvious errors in logs after mapping.
infra-bot: autoscaler adjusted concurrency for demux-v2 on prod-2 to 120 -> 240 at 2026-03-17T11:42Z (manual).
Samir P: Quick snapshot: queue_length back to normal, p90 latency improved from 1.9s -> 0.6s, dropped_count down to near-zero.
Jun Park: Re-ingest + attribution run complete: token counts reconciled to 98.7% of expected for the window. Only ~1.3% still missing (likely transient).
Maya R: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: - Casey please open a short RFC for the schema rename process and add a gating checklist. - Samir, Jun: run one more end-to-end smoke after tomorrow's jobs.
Casey L: Will create RFC and add the checklist items (schemas, cross-team notification, fallback tests).
Samir P: I'll schedule the smoke for 09:00 UTC tomorrow and invite relevant owners.
Maya R: Closing the loop here — marking this thread resolved for now. Please keep updates in the RFC and ping if residual drift appears. :thumbsup:
